methods: Differentiable Computer Vision, LoFTR, DISK, HardNet, Scale-Space Features, Affine Warping
pros: GPU-accelerated PyTorch native operators, sub-pixel differentiable corner detection, batch processing
cons: Requires PyTorch GPU runtime; heavy dependency overhead for edge deployment
relevance_to_sem: Provides benchmark LoFTR and feature matching operators

methods: LightGlue: Local Feature Matching at Light Speed with Transformer pruning
pros: Ultra-fast feature matching, adaptive depth early stopping, rejection of unmatchable points
cons: Dependent on quality of input keypoint detector (SuperPoint/DISK)
relevance_to_sem: Useful for sparse landmark matching across clean vs noisy pairs

methods: Detector-Free Local Feature Matching with Transformers
pros: Matches low-texture regions through coarse-to-fine dense attention maps
cons: Heavy compute; periodic repetitions produce diffused multi-modal attention
relevance_to_sem: High reference for coarse-to-fine attention mechanisms

methods: matchTemplate (ZNCC, CCOEFF_NORMED), PhaseCorrelate, SIFT, ORB, ECC, createHanningWindow
pros: Highly optimized C++ / Python bindings, CPU fast execution (<25ms), standard industry deployment
cons: Classical methods require custom multi-stream fusion to handle periodic SEM ambiguity
relevance_to_sem: Core backbone for low-latency production deployment

methods: SAM (Segment Anything Model) Promptable Visual Segmentation
pros: Zero-shot structural boundary and mask segmentation
cons: Very heavy model (>1GB weights), inference time >1s per frame
relevance_to_sem: Topology extraction and macro separator strip segmentation

methods: PatchCore: Memory-guided Memory Bank Patch Nearest Neighbor Anomaly & Localization
pros: Coreset subsampling, memory retrieval without retraining, robust to subtle deviations
cons: Designed for anomaly detection rather than sub-pixel coordinate regression
relevance_to_sem: Direct inspiration for Wafer Memory Graph and Historical Defect Priors

methods: DINOv2: Learning Robust Visual Features without Supervision
pros: Dense semantic feature tokens, invariant to severe noise and contrast degradation
cons: 14px patch token grid limits fine registration

methods: DeDoDe: Detect, Don't Displace - Decoupled Feature Detector & Descriptor
pros: Accurate keypoint positioning without descriptor-driven spatial displacement
relevance_to_sem: Sub-pixel keypoint accuracy on repetitive semiconductor corners
